assumptions.prices: Alpaca SIP daily bars, adjustment=all (splits + dividends)
assumptions.returns: total_ret_pct = cumulative return on TOTAL account equity over the period; cagr_pct annualized; mean_trade_pct = per invested dollar

SPY.step: as reported by lab 2 (same-close fills, simple RSI, 0.02% slip)
+ fill at the NEXT OPEN instead of the signal close

QQQ.step: as reported by lab 2 (same-close fills, simple RSI, 0.02% slip)
+ fill at the NEXT OPEN instead of the signal close

options_probe.verdict: No historical option quotes (bid/ask) from this data source. Per the rules, the 45-60 DTE call-spread test is NOT run; trade-based bars or modeled prices are not executable fills.

risk_of_ruin.note: Block bootstrap (10-session blocks) of this strategy's own historical daily account returns, 2016-2026. Assumes the future looks like a reshuffled past; real crashes can be worse. 32x needs ~17.9% per session for 21 sessions.

trials.note: The 2024+ daily test was seen once in lab 2 when choosing threshold 10 over 5 (2 thresholds x 2 symbols). April-November 2026 intraday results are selection-contaminated: lab 1 -> lab 2 changes were made after seeing them.
